testsuite.name: D - AhmedAzad240358 - Search filters and sorting
testsuite.details:
Member 4 / D, baseline TaskFlow main@5133a6c. Test basis: README.md TF-REQ-019 and Behaviour notes. Code: src/utils/tasks.js filterAndSortTasks/SORT_OPTIONS; src/components/TaskToolbar.jsx, TopBar.jsx, TaskList.jsx; src/App.jsx clearFilters.

Fixture CORE installed afresh before each independent case in a disposable Chrome profile through DevTools Console/localStorage taskflow_tasks, then location.reload(): six records, IDs d1-d6. d1: Alpha Planning | Build the billing dashboard | High | To Do | due 2026-11-30 | created 2026-01-10T08:00:00Z. d2: Alpha Support | Reconcile monthly billing | High | In Progress | due 2026-11-20 | created 2026-01-10T10:00:00Z. d3: Beta Launch | Prepare user notes | Medium | To Do | due 2026-11-20 | created 2026-01-05T09:00:00Z. d4: Gamma Review | Alpha appears in notes | Low | Completed | no due date | created 2026-01-15T08:00:00Z. d5: Alpha-100% (urgent) | Review [QA]? | Low | In Progress | due 2027-02-01 | created 2026-01-15T12:00:00Z. d6: Undated Later | No deadline | Medium | Completed | no due date | created 2026-01-20T08:00:00Z. For each record updatedAt equals createdAt; dueDate without a date is empty string. The explicit one-record and zero-record exceptions are stated in their case preconditions.

Reset taskflow_tasks and taskflow_tasks_backup before each case; fixture creation is setup only. Open http://localhost:5173, use Dashboard, and do not use UI CRUD as an assertion. Sort labels are Newest first, Oldest first, Due date: soonest, Due date: latest. Cases are manual and initially Not Run.
